name: H-boxes absorb |1⟩
summary: An X-state with phase π (|1⟩) on a leg of an H-box can be removed, lowering the arity of the H-box.
description:
Plugging the basis state $|1\rangle$ (an arity-1 X-spider with phase $\pi$) into a leg of an H-box gives the H-box with that leg removed and the same label: the AND of $1$ and $x$ is just $x$. Together with [|0⟩ explodes an H-box](../zh-h-box-zero-state-copy/) this describes how H-boxes act on computational basis states.

It holds for H-boxes with an arbitrary label, and follows from [labelled H-box fusion](../zh-h-box-fusion-labelled/).
parameter_notes: Shown for an H-box with n = 2 other legs; holds for any n.
notes: The H-boxes here are *unnormalised*: an H-box with label $a$ has all entries equal to $1$, except for the entry where all wires are $1$, which is $a$. The grey spiders of the ZH papers are normalised differently from the X-spiders of PyZX, so scalar factors may differ from those in the papers.
